notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for directed object-class interaction publication service reports. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM with a directed interaction declaration, standard MIM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies successful and failed PublishObjectClassDirectedInteractions and UnpublishObjectClassDirectedInteractions HLAreportServiceInvocation payloads, including the whole-class unpublish form, without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.
